case.title: Design: the CSV's filter lines put Priced By before Category
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Click Download Summary (CSV) in the ⋯ menu.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens; the download is the real file the stand-in of picture 20.20 shows.

Step 2:

  • After "Sales Type: All" the file reads "Priced By: All", then "Category: All categories", then "Customer: All customers", as in picture 20.20.
